name: Move between letters from a letter station

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle
Click the 'Toast' letter on the chart, then click 'Details' in the letter card to open its station
Verify the next letter's station page is displayed
Verify the Toast station page is displayed again
